literal_meaning: সুগন্ধযুক্ত ঘাসের আসনে বসানো হওয়া (honored seating on fragrant grass mat)
figurative_meaning_en: Receiving attention, respect, or honor in social gatherings; being shown care and regard
similar_in_english: To be held in high regard
To get the red carpet treatment
To be given pride of place
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজে তার কলিকা পাওয়ার মতো মর্যাদা এখন আর নেই।
অতিথিদের কলিকা পেয়ে তারা খুব খুশি হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He no longer receives the respect in society that he once did, like getting kalika.
The guests were delighted to be shown such honor, as if receiving kalika.
history: Referenced in the works of Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar: 'আর তাহারা আমার কাছে কলিকা পাইবে না' (They will no longer receive honor from me)
Originates from traditional Hindu customs where kalika (fragrant grass) mats were used for seating honored guests in rituals and gatherings
note: The idiom draws from ancient Bengali-Hindu traditions of hospitality and ritual seating.
